content: Spring AI 2.0.x docs claim support for Boot 4.0.x and 4.1.x, but 2.0.0/2.0.1 artifacts are built against Boot 4.1.x (issue spring-projects/spring-ai#6465, open). With Gradle io.spring.dependency-management, Boot artifacts are pinned to the app's Boot version; probe confirmed Spring AI 2.0.1 Anthropic autoconfig loads on Boot 4.0.8. Spring AI 2.0.1 (2026-08-20) fixes 7 CVEs in modules myfeeder does not use.
